fact: 1918年2月6日，《人民代表法》获御准：21岁以上男性、19岁以上的军中男性、以及30岁以上符合地方政府选举资格（本人或丈夫具备财产资格）的女性获得投票权，约840万女性入册；选民总数由约800万增至约2,100万。

sources.title: UK Parliament, The Representation of the People Act 1918
sources.quote: The Act gave the vote to all men aged 21 years or older and to men on military or naval service from the age of 19. Women aged 30 or older who qualified for the local government franchise, or whose husbands did, were given the vote – approximately 8.4 million women. ... The Act received Royal Assent on 6 February 1918.

sources.title: The Gazette, Representation of the People Act 1918
sources.quote: The Representation of the People Act increased the electorate from 8 to 21 million, yet a huge gulf remained between women and men. ... An estimated 2 million women took on jobs formally carried out by men, taking the number of women in total employment from 24 per cent in July 1914 to 37 per cent by November 1918.

fact: 1918年11月21日，《议会（女性资格）法》获御准，女性首次可以竞选下议院议员；该法在议会解散当日通过，全文 operative words 仅27词，被认为是英国最短的法案之一。

sources.title: House of Commons Library, Women in the House of Commons（Research Briefing SN06651, PDF）
sources.quote: the Parliament (Qualification of Women) Bill was introduced by Lord Robert Cecil, a Government Minister, on 31 October. It was passed, almost without opposition, within three weeks, and received Royal Assent on 21 November, the day that Parliament was dissolved, some three weeks before the General Election.

sources.title: 1918 United Kingdom general election, Wikiwand
sources.quote: It was also the first parliamentary election in which women were able to stand as candidates, following the Parliament (Qualification of Women) Act 1918 ... At 27 operative words, it is believed to be one of the shortest Acts of Parliament.

fact: 1918年12月14日举行大选：投票率57.2%（10,442,883票），联合政府（保守党379席＋联合自由党127席等）共获约520席，工党57席首次成为正式反对党，新芬党73席并拒绝就座于威斯敏斯特，前首相阿斯奎斯失去东法夫议席。这是英国首次有女性投票、也是首次有女性候选人的大选。

sources.title: 1918 United Kingdom general election, Wikiwand
sources.quote: a general election was held in the United Kingdom on Saturday, 14 December 1918. ... Turnout 10,442,883 57.2% ... Seats won 379 127 73 57 36 7 ... Nearly all the Liberal MPs without coupons were defeated, including party leader and former Prime Minister H. H. Asquith.

sources.title: Morgan K. O., Lloyd George and the Hard-faced Men, 1918–22, Journal of Liberal History（PDF）
sources.quote: the returns announced just after Christmas declared that the coalition had 521 supporters returned by an overwhelming landslide victory with over 5 million votes behind them ... The opposition consisted of only a few small fragments, fifty-seven Labour (though representing almost two and a half million votes), thirty-six anti-coalition Liberals ... and seventy-three Irish Sinn Fein republicans

fact: 1918年11月11日上午10时20分，英国新闻局发布官方公告，首相劳合·乔治宣布：「停战协定已于今晨五时签署，敌对行动将于今日上午11时在所有战线停止。」消息由新闻局以官方公告形式向英国公众发布。

sources.title: Armistice of 11 November 1918（英文维基百科条目镜像）
sources.quote: The British public was notified of the armistice by a subjoined official communiqué issued from the Press Bureau at 10:20 a.m., when British Prime Minister David Lloyd George announced: "The armistice was signed at five o'clock this morning, and hostilities are to cease on all fronts at 11 a.m. to-day."

fact: 英国1918年1月起对糖实行强制配给，到4月底肉、黄油、奶酪与人造黄油相继纳入配给；7月起向家庭发放国家配给簿，持有人须在指定的糖商、肉商与杂货商处登记，凭撕下的联单购买。配给制并未随停战结束：肉配给持续到1919年，黄油到1920年才解禁。

sources.title: Amgueddfa Cymru / Museum Wales, St Fagans First World War Trail（PDF，含1918年国家配给簿图版）
sources.quote: Food rationing was introduced in 1918, starting with sugar in January, followed by meat, butter, cheese and margarine in April. Everyone received a ration book and had to register with a local butcher and grocer.

sources.title: The History Press, Bread: A slice of First World War history
sources.quote: Ration books were issued to households in July 1918 and everyone had to register with a local butcher and grocer. The scheme continued after the war: meat was rationed until 1919 and rationing didn't finally end until 1920.

fact: 作为配给制的补充，英国政府推动地方当局开设「国家厨房」（National Kitchens），以成本价供应营养餐；第一家于1917年5月21日由玛丽王后在伦敦开设，到1918年底全国已有363家。

sources.title: The History Press, Bread: A slice of First World War history
sources.quote: In May 1917, the Food Controller encouraged local authorities to set up National Kitchens and Restaurants, where ostensibly healthy, nourishing and properly prepared food was served at cost ... The first National Kitchen was opened by Queen Mary in London on 21 May 1917 and by late 1918 there were 363 kitchens nationwide.

fact: 1918年英国的食品管制建立在1914年《王国国防法》（DORA）授予的广泛授权之上：政府可绕过议会管制物价、征用物资、限制营业时间与酒馆售酒；1917年7月起食品管制官对基本食品实行限价，并把执行下放到地方食品管制委员会，由其登记零售商、核定零售价并推行节食宣传。

sources.title: North Hertfordshire Museum, Remembering Wartime
sources.quote: The Defence of the Realm Act (DORA) had been established in 1914 in order to ensure food shortages did not occur ... In January 1918 sugar was rationed, and by the end of April butter, margarine, cheese and meat were added to the list.

sources.title: The History Press, Bread: A slice of First World War history
sources.quote: Controlled prices were introduced by the new Food Controller, Lord Rhondda, in July 1917, fixing the prices of essential foods of which the supply could be controlled. This work was decentralised to local food control committees who were to enforce the Food Controller's Orders, register the retailers of various foodstuffs

fact: 英国国债由开战时的约6.45亿英镑增至1918年3月31日的约58.72亿英镑，再增至1919年3月31日的74.35亿英镑；其中内债约60.85亿、外债约13.5亿英镑。盟国与自治领欠英国的债务为17.39亿英镑（自治领1.71亿、盟国15.68亿）。

sources.title: Hansard, Commons, Ways and Means, 1919-04-30（财政大臣 Chamberlain 的预算演说）
sources.quote: The National Debt proper ... was at the outbreak of the War approximately £645,000,000. On the 31st March of last year the total was in round figures £5,872,000,000, and on the 31st March this year the total was £7,435,000,000 ... Of the Capital Debt incurred, internal debt accounts for approximately £6,085,000,000 and external debt for approximately £1,350,000,000. ... the obligations of our Allies and Dominions, amounting on the 31st March of this year to £1,739,000,000.

fact: 英国的战时小额储蓄工具条款：战争储蓄券按每张15先令6便士发行，若全部持满五年可按1英镑兑付（由此产生的额外负债约6,500万英镑）；国民战争债券按溢价赎回，溢价部分构成5,171.6万英镑的额外负债。

sources.title: Hansard, Commons, Ways and Means, 1919-04-30
sources.quote: A considerable part of the debt is represented by National War Bonds repayable at a premium, and the premiums on those Bonds represent a further liability of £51,716,000. Further, the War Savings Certificates are allowed for at 15s. 6d. each and if they are all held for five years they will be repayable at a £1, which would then involve an additional obligation of £65,000,000.

fact: 按 Johnson 与 Mueller 的跨国统计，英格兰与威尔士在1918—1919年流感大流行中死亡约20万人、死亡率5.8‰；苏格兰27,650—33,771人（5.7—6.9‰）；爱尔兰18,367人（4.3‰）。同一张表列西班牙257,082人（12.3‰）、德国225,330人（3.8‰）。

sources.title: Ager P., et al., The Redistributive Effects of Pandemics: Evidence of the Spanish Flu, LSE Economic History Working Paper 308（表1，据 Johnson & Mueller 2002）
sources.quote: England and Wales approx. 200,000 5.8 ... Scotland 27,650-33,771 5.7-6.9 ... Eire 18,367 4.3 ... Spain 257,082 12.3 ... Germany 225,330 3.8 ... Table 1: Mortality rates per 1,000, Spanish Flu.

fact: 战时英国约200万女性接替了原由男性承担的工作，女性占总就业的比例由1914年7月的24%升至1918年11月的37%；这一变化是1918年《人民代表法》得以通过的社会背景之一。

sources.title: The Gazette, Representation of the People Act 1918
sources.quote: After the outbreak of war in 1914, women played an increasingly important role in the war effort. An estimated 2 million women took on jobs formally carried out by men, taking the number of women in total employment from 24 per cent in July 1914 to 37 per cent by November 1918.
